reset: Reset puts the original settings.json back.
title: OneLake settings: external app access, file explorer, shortcut cache
objective_text: Set the tenant settings the OneLake file explorer needs and a workspace's shortcut cache, and predict what the cache keeps.
scenario: Analysts can't open OneLake in the file explorer app, and an S3 shortcut is read so often that egress costs are climbing. The settings were changed in a hurry and don't add up.
engine_label: A model of OneLake's tenant and workspace settings, checked on this PC
verifies: Your settings let the file explorer work and cache the S3 shortcut for a week, and your expectations match how the cache behaves, as the OneLake pages describe it, checked against a model on this PC.
does_not_verify: That any setting changes in Fabric: nothing is set here.
Who may change tenant settings, and security groups that a tenant setting can be limited to.

expected.description: Both tenant settings on; shortcut cache on with 7 days; the 3 GB file isn't cached; each read resets retention.

validation.fail: The OneLake file explorer won't work for the analysts.
validation.pass: Both tenant settings the file explorer needs are on.

rules.why: The file explorer runs outside Fabric, so it also needs the external apps setting.

validation.fail: The S3 shortcut won't be cached as the team needs.
validation.pass: Caching is on with a one-week retention.

rules.why: Shortcut caching covers GCS, S3, S3 compatible and on-premises gateway shortcuts.
Retention is set between 1 and 28 days.

validation.fail: The cache doesn't behave the way you expect.
validation.pass: You know which files are cached and how long they stay.

rules.why: Each time a file is accessed, its retention period is reset.

hints: The file explorer is an app outside Fabric. Which tenant setting covers that?
What range can the cache's retention take?
Is there a size above which a file isn't cached?
explanation: The OneLake file explorer needs its own tenant setting and, because it runs outside Fabric, the setting that lets apps external to Fabric reach OneLake. Shortcut caching is a workspace setting for GCS, S3, S3 compatible and gateway shortcuts: retention is 1 to 28 days and resets each time a file is read, and files over 1 GB aren't cached.
review_notes: Checked on Learn 2026-11-06: onelake-file-explorer (its own tenant setting; also needs the external apps setting), get-started-security (the external apps tenant setting), onelake-shortcuts caching (1-28 days, reset on access, files over 1 GB not cached, GCS/S3/S3 compatible/gateway, set on the workspace's OneLake tab).
